insights.claim: Eligible transaction volume varies substantially by month across 2009–2011.
Line spend is heavily right-skewed; a small share of lines dominate monetary value.
United Kingdom accounts for the large majority of eligible spend in this dataset.
Cancellation-marked rows are a persistent minority of activity and must be handled explicitly in spend targets.
Quantity and unit price show extreme outliers; RFM monetary sums will be sensitive to these tails.

caveat: Insights are descriptive associations from this historical dataset, not causal claims about marketing actions.
